name: ProEquity Asset Management
summary: ProEquity Asset Management is a full-service commercial real estate management and advisory firm founded in 2012, serving clients across 17 states. The company specializes in comprehensive asset management solutions, receivership services, and strategic property advisory for commercial real estate owners and investors.
demographics: The Wharton, Texas location serves a diverse commercial real estate clientele including property owners, investors, and institutional clients across multiple states. The primary market consists of business professionals and commercial property stakeholders seeking asset management, fiduciary services, and strategic real estate advisory. The trade area extends beyond the local Wharton community to encompass a regional and national client base, with decision-makers typically representing middle to upper-income commercial entities and investment groups seeking professional property management solutions.
description: ProEquity Asset Management, located at 10314 U.S. 59 in Wharton, Texas, represents a professional commercial real estate management and advisory firm rather than a traditional shopping center. Founded in 2012, ProEquity has rapidly grown to become one of the fastest-growing commercial real estate management, fiduciary, and advisory firms in the United States, earning recognition among the Inc. 5000 Fastest-Growing Companies. Licensed in 17 states with employees across the nation, the company provides comprehensive solutions for commercial real estate owners and investors by leveraging over 100 years of combined partner-level experience. ProEquity specializes in tailored business solutions, offering a full platform of services including asset management, receivership services, and property advisory to help clients navigate the volatility of economic and market conditions. The firm prides itself on providing superior roadmaps that allow clients to understand specific market dynamics and proactively position their assets for exceptional results in competitive marketplaces.
